headline: Khaitan advises President of India on ₹5,549 cr Coal India share sale
sum: The Government sold ~12.33 cr Coal India shares via the offer-for-sale route, raising ~₹5,549 cr - a marquee disinvestment mandate.
detail: The President of India, acting through the Ministry of Coal, made an offer for sale of 123,279,566 equity shares of Coal India Limited through the stock-exchange mechanism, aggregating to approximately ₹5,549 crore. Khaitan & Co advised the seller. Axis Capital, ICICI Securities, JM Financial, Kotak Securities and SBICAP Securities acted as brokers to the offer.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “The President of India, acting through the Ministry of Coal…has made an offer for sale of 123,279,566 equity shares of Coal India…aggregating to approximately ₹5,549 crore.” - confirms Khaitan's mandate and the broker syndicate.

sources.name: Business Standard
sources.blurb: Adds market reception: ₹412 floor price, 2% stake (1% base + 1% green-shoe), non-retail portion subscribed over 4x.

sources.name: India Infoline
sources.blurb: Confirms the divestment context - part of the Government's FY27 disinvestment programme; promoter holding falling from 63.13% to 61.13%.
